content.text: {"route":"gap","reason":"The record has material gaps on the pay claims (10 and 11). The Agency found a prima facie EPA case, then accepted a \"factor other than sex\" defense without documentary support. There are no pay-setting records, salary histories, or reasons why CW1 and CW2 started at higher pay. CW3, who was alleged to be paid more and to have taken over her position, is not addressed in the decision. The \"back-fill\" and \"time in service\" rationales are not tested against Complainant's claim of comparable or greater experience: 17 years of service and prior lead and manager roles. The record also does not show how those factors were applied consistently to other employees. On the performance claims, CW2's PDA is compared only through the Branch Supervisor's own account, and the comparison uses different rating scales (4.0 vs 5.1 and 7 vs 9). The record shows no independent witnesses beyond the alleged discriminating officials. The mid-year review and rating claims lack the underlying documents, such as the actual reviews, rating criteria, and work samples. There is also no analysis of how other employees were rated or of pretext. The Agency's hostile work environment and discrimination findings are conclusory, and the record cannot be evaluated adequately without these items."}
